kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحترم (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِمُ (ʔaḥtarimu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# أُحْتَرَمُ (ʔuḥtaramu) /ʔuħ.ta.ra.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# أَحْتَرِمَ (ʔaḥtarima) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# أُحْتَرَمَ (ʔuḥtarama) /ʔuħ.ta.ra
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
